primaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: Increase in CR/CRi rate by 57 percentage points (from ~25% to 82%)
primaryOutcomes.baseline: Expected CR/CRi rate for relapsed/refractory B-cell ALL with standard salvage therapy: ~25%
primaryOutcomes.name: Complete Remission (CR/CRi) Rate

primaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: Increase in MRD negativity rate by 73 percentage points (from ~10% to 83%)
primaryOutcomes.baseline: Expected MRD negativity rate among CR/CRi relapsed/refractory B-cell ALL patients with prior therapies: ~10%
primaryOutcomes.name: Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) Negativity Rate (among CR/CRi patients)

primaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: Increase in 12-month EFS rate by 40 percentage points (from ~10% to 50%)
primaryOutcomes.baseline: Expected 12-month EFS rate for relapsed/refractory B-cell ALL with standard salvage therapy: ~10%
primaryOutcomes.name: 12-Month Event-Free Survival (EFS) Rate

secondaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: Increase in 24-month OS rate by 28 percentage points (from ~15% to 43%)
secondaryOutcomes.baseline: Expected 24-month OS rate for relapsed/refractory B-cell ALL with standard salvage therapy: ~15%
secondaryOutcomes.name: 24-Month Overall Survival (OS) Rate

secondaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: +20 points on KPS (from 70 to 90, indicating normal activity with some effort, minor signs of disease)
secondaryOutcomes.baseline: KPS: 70 (indicating able to care for self but unable to do normal activity or work, pre-treatment)
secondaryOutcomes.name: Karnofsky Performance Status (KPS)

secondaryOutcomes.absoluteChange: +20 points on PedsQL Total Score (from 50 to 70)
secondaryOutcomes.baseline: PedsQL Total Score: 50 (on a 0-100 scale, lower scores indicate worse QoL, pre-treatment)
secondaryOutcomes.name: Patient-Reported Quality of Life (PedsQL Total Score)
